the deformation mechanism of GH4720Li alloy changes from dislocation cross-slip at room temperature to dislocation planar slip at 400 /C176C, and then to nanotwin and stacking fault mechanism at 600 /C176C, which may be related to the decrease in the stacking fault energy of the alloy with the increase in temperature.
